claims: Runge-Kutta order conditions, stability functions and A-stability
RK45 = Dormand-Prince 5(4) embedded pair; rtol/atol error control

checks: Classical RK4 on y'=-y to t=5: error 3.05e-8 (h=0.1), 1.83e-9 (h=0.05); observed order ~ 4.06
Forward Euler observed order ~ 0.95, Heun ~ 2.06 on the same problem
Stability function R(z): Euler 1+z; RK2 1+z+z^2/2; RK4 1+z+z^2/2+z^3/6+z^4/24
Real-axis stability intervals: Euler [-2,0], RK2 [-2,0], RK4 ~ [-2.785,0]
RK4 on y'=-100y: h=0.02 (|h*lambda|=2) stable, h=0.03 (|h*lambda|=3) diverges (~3.7e4)
RK4 weight 1:2:2:1 matches Simpson quadrature weights
